```{r, load libraries}
#| output: FALSE
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(psych)
library(gt)
library(janitor)
```

```{r, load data}
#| output: FALSE
#loading data
data<-read_excel("./Attachment_Anxiety_Data.xlsx")

# inspecting data
head(data)
```

```{r, clean data}
#| output: FALSE
data.clean <- data |>
  mutate(Gender = case_when(
    Gender == 1 ~ "Male",
    Gender == 2 ~ "Female",
    TRUE ~ NA
  )) |>
  mutate(`Age group` = case_when(
    `Age group` == 1 ~ "18-24",
    `Age group` == 2 ~ "24-34",
    `Age group` == 3 ~ "35-44",
    `Age group` == 4 ~ "45-54",
    `Age group` == 5 ~ "55-64",
    TRUE ~ NA
  )) |>
  mutate_at(7:45, as.integer)


```
